item.title: Natural spinel exists in several vivid colors
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Spinel is a distinct gem mineral and occurs in reds, pinks, purples, blues and other colors.
EXIMUTC view: Confirm natural origin and treatment with evidence before comparing vivid spinels.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/spinel-description
